What will you find at the CONTROL Exhibition?
 
✨ METRIOS 332 with RE-Light rotary axis

Metrios 332 is the ideal choice for measuring large, heavy and complex components and for multi-part measurements.
With the RE-Light rotary axis integrated, you will be able to measure all surfaces at once with a single device. It automatically finds the reference point to orientate your measurement.
You only need to place the part and let Metrios Re-light do the rest!


✨  New Metrios software realease

Discover the brand new 3.1 version of the Metrios software, with a new design for a better UX experience and top interesting features.


✨  Industrial automation through Metrios and GESSbot integration

In collaboration with W.Gessmann GmbH, we will showcase the perfect example of industrial automation by implementing the automated GESSbot cobot with the Metrios machine. 
What is the result? Robot integration enhances workflows,boosts efficiency, and guarantees seamless operations.
